insert into DIS_PRAAMS_SUB (TAB_NUM, DIS_ID, DIS_ORDER, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME)
select #{dto.tabNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.disId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.disOrder,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{dto.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{dto.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{dto.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} from dual
mapper.select: select TAB_NUM tabNum, DIS_ID disId, DIS_ORDER disOrder from DIS_PRAAMS_SUB where TAB_NUM = #{tabNum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update:
MERGE INTO DIS_PRAAMS_SUB DPS USING (
SELECT #{item.tabNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} TAB_NUM, #{item.disId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DIS_ID, #{item.disOrder,jdbcType=VARCHAR} DIS_ORDER, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM dual
) TEMP
ON( DPS.TAB_NUM = TEMP.TAB_NUM AND DPS.DIS_ID = TEMP.DIS_ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DPS.DIS_ORDER = TEMP.DIS_ORDER, DPS.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, DPS.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, DPS.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, DPS.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, DPS.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TAB_NUM, DIS_ID, DIS_ORDER, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( TEMP.TAB_NUM, TEMP.DIS_ID, TEMP.DIS_ORDER, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME )
